objective: Bring up the RLC out of ROM execution, with RLC_GPM_STAT.RLC_EXEC_ROM_CODE going 1 to 0 as the only accepted proof
not_covered: init_csb and update_spm_vmid were NOT done: both need a clear state buffer this lab does not build
RLC_GPM_UCODE_ADDR/DATA are write-only (0xFFFFFFFF on both Windows and Linux); the ADDR readback is an indication, not proof
Nothing about the CP was touched: no unhalt, no ring, no PM4
A running RLC is not a running CP: that is the next step, not this one

gates.detail: Sem caminho de volta provado, o driver recusa escrever em registrador do RLC.
Os 4 registradores de configuracao do RLC ficam guardados no driver.
ENABLE_F32 a 0, CGCG_CGLS_CTRL a 0 e PG_CNTL a 0, cada um com readback conferido.
RLC_CGCG_CGLS_CTRL = 0, igual ao Linux com o CP vivo (era 0x0001003C).
